verdict.rationale: Unleash documents self-hosting its open-source distribution: cloning the repository and running the server with Docker Compose in your own environment. A community member independently recommends it as an open-source, self-hosted LaunchDarkly alternative. Edge docs state that targeting PII is processed locally and never sent upstream, though that refers to Enterprise Edge. Missing for 10: confirmation that the open-source build includes the full platform (RBAC, change requests, SSO and SCIM appear tied to hosted/Enterprise tiers), and explicit docs that evaluation data stays on-prem for the OSS server itself rather than only for Enterprise Edge.
